_comment: zh_CN texts for the German table kampf_k01b. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_CN.

strings.%s's Energy is locked: it gains none thi: %s的能量被锁住了：本回合得不到能量。
strings.A swipe with whatever lies around. Weak,: 随手抓起身边的东西一扫。很弱，但不花能量。
strings.Arts that cost 5 Energy or more cost 1 l: 消耗5点或更多能量的技艺少消耗1点。
strings.Draws one long, slow breath: gains 3 Ene: 缓缓深吸一口气：获得3点能量，但步速下降1。
strings.Hands up to %d of its Energy to the ally: 把自己最多%d点能量交给身旁的同伴。
strings.Holds up a mirror to the foe's charge: t: 向对手的充能举起镜子：双方交换能量。
strings.Keepsake. The holder starts every battle: 信物。持有者每场战斗开始时多2点能量。
strings.Passes up to 3 of its own Energy to the: 把自己最多3点能量交给身旁的同伴。
strings.Snaps the foe's fuse: it gains no Energy: 掐断对手的引线：本回合结束时对手得不到能量。
strings.Teaches Charge Mirror to any Spirling. N: 教会任意Spirling充能镜。永不消耗。
strings.Teaches Fuse Snap to any Spirling. Never: 教会任意Spirling断线击。永不消耗。
strings.Teaches Long Breath to any Spirling. Nev: 教会任意Spirling长呼吸。永不消耗。
strings.Teaches Scrap Swipe to any Spirling. Nev: 教会任意Spirling杂物扫击。永不消耗。
strings.Teaches Spark Share to any Spirling. Nev: 教会任意Spirling火花分享。永不消耗。
对手%d回合内得不到能量。
strings.Where it is the place's own field, %s ar: 若这是当地本身的场地，%s技艺少消耗%d点能量。
